raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

On ROCm, the DeepSeek-V4 / V4.1 sparse-MLA decode builders pack the ragged indices in two steps on every decode step: `build_ragged_indices_from_dense()` allocates scratch `counts`, `indptr` and `flat` tensors, then `_copy_ragged_to_graph_buffers()` copies `indptr` and `flat` into the persistent buffers that FULL decode CUDA graphs captured. This runs 3 times per decode step on V4 (C128A and SWA) and 7 times on V4.1 (SWA).

This PR:

- Adds `build_ragged_indices_from_dense_out()`, which runs the count → scan → compact kernels from #58058 directly into caller-owned buffers. Counts are written into `indptr[1:]` and scanned in place. `build_ragged_indices_from_dense()` becomes an allocating wrapper around it, so the `-1` filtering has one implementation.
- Uses it in the V4 C128A/SWA and V4.1 SWA decode `build()`. The gfx950 width narrowing that `_decode_gfx950_num_splits` reads is unchanged.
- Adds a ROCm `update_draft_decode_metadata()` that repacks the ragged SWA buffers in place, and sets `supports_draft_decode_metadata_update = True` on the ROCm SWA builders so fused multi-step draft decode can run. This path comes from #52628 (co-authored by Tres Popp).

Prefill callers of `build_ragged_indices_from_dense()` get the same output. #57860 fuses indptr into a different V4.1 pack kernel and composes with this PR.

## Test Plan

MI355X (gfx950), `--kv-cache-dtype fp8`, `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1`, main `72e7874fa6`.

- Unit: `pytest tests/v1/attention/test_deepseek_v4_rocm_metadata.py tests/kernels/attention/test_rocm_triton_attn_dsv4.py`. New cases put `-1` inside a row's valid length, cover `num_rows` filtering, scan sizes across block boundaries and empty input, and check that the V4 draft update rewrites the ragged buffers without replacing their storage.
- Micro: the production helpers at serving shapes, off-grid row counts, 5 % `-1` sentinels. Four consecutive runs per arm, the first discarded, median of runs 2–4.
- e2e: a fresh server per run, 4 runs per arm per block with the first discarded, one server on the host at a time. V4.1 adds `--tensor-parallel-size 2`. The MTP config adds `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1` and `--speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":3}'`, the path that runs fused multi-step draft decode.

```bash
vllm serve deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --max-model-len 8192 --no-enable-prefix-caching --trust-remote-code
vllm bench serve --model deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash --dataset-name random --random-input-len 1031 --random-output-len 509 \
    --random-range-ratio 0.25 --num-prompts 509 --max-concurrency 61 --request-rate inf --ignore-eos --seed 1234
```

- Accuracy: `lm_eval --model local-completions --tasks gsm8k --num_fewshot 5`, greedy, `max_gen_toks=256`, `seed=1234`. The base arm was run twice.

## Test Result

**Unit:** 124 passed on MI355X (gfx950), main `863475eb9c`. The V4.1 `update_draft_decode_metadata()` mirrors the V4 one but has no test: V4.1 supports only DSpark speculation, so no end-to-end run reaches it.

**Micro**, MI355X (gfx950), torch 2.12.0, main `72e7874fa6`. Per call of what `build()` runs:

| shape (rows × width) | main µs (r2–4) | PR µs (r2–4) | Δ |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| SWA 1×128 | 56.5 (55.5–57.1) | 40.9 (40.7–41.5) | -15.6 µs (-27.6 %) |
| SWA 50×128 | 55.9 (55.6–56.4) | 40.9 (40.8–41.2) | -14.9 µs (-26.7 %) |
| SWA 257×128 | 56.1 (56.0–56.6) | 41.0 (40.7–41.1) | -15.1 µs (-27.0 %) |
| SWA 511×128 | 56.2 (56.2–56.8) | 40.8 (40.8–41.2) | -15.4 µs (-27.4 %) |
| C128A 50×512 | 56.3 (55.7–57.5) | 41.1 (40.9–41.2) | -15.2 µs (-27.1 %) |
| C128A 129×512 | 56.1 (56.1–57.0) | 40.9 (40.8–41.1) | -15.2 µs (-27.1 %) |

Ranges are disjoint at every shape, and both arms produce identical `indptr` and indices. Per call, the profiler shows 5 kernels, 3 allocations and 2 `hipMemcpyAsync` on main, and 3 kernels with no allocation or copy with this PR. The saving is flat in row count, about 45 µs per decode step on V4 and 105 µs on V4.1.

**e2e**, 509 prompts in 1031 / out 509, concurrency 61. The saving is below the run-to-run spread, so no end-to-end speedup is claimed; per-run numbers are in the first comment.

| DeepSeek-V4-Flash, TP=1: median of runs 2–4 (range) | main | PR | Δ |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Total tok/s | 5805 (5682–5879) | 5887 (5788–5915) | +1.4 % |
| Mean TTFT (ms) | 301.0 (296.8–714.4) | 296.0 (292.0–480.7) | -1.6 % |
| Median TTFT (ms) | 134.6 (134.4–142.0) | 134.5 (132.8–135.4) | -0.1 % |
| Mean TPOT (ms) | 30.19 (29.92–30.29) | 29.86 (29.71–30.04) | -1.1 % |
| Median TPOT (ms) | 30.59 (30.54–31.05) | 30.57 (30.37–30.57) | -0.1 % |

| DeepSeek-V4-Flash, MTP × 3: median of runs 2–4 (range) | main | PR | Δ |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Total tok/s | 5646 (5587–5669) | 5684 (5634–5685) | +0.7 % |
| Mean TTFT (ms) | 321.7 (314.5–329.2) | 320.7 (317.6–323.2) | -0.3 % |
| Median TTFT (ms) | 180.3 (157.3–182.8) | 161.7 (158.4–167.0) | -10.3 % |
| Mean TPOT (ms) | 31.06 (30.96–31.27) | 30.95 (30.95–31.09) | -0.4 % |
| Median TPOT (ms) | 30.25 (30.19–30.76) | 30.06 (30.05–30.62) | -0.6 % |

| DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, TP=2: median of runs 2–4 (range) | main | PR | Δ |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Total tok/s | 5784 (5484–5812) | 5575 (5553–5827) | -3.6 % |
| Mean TTFT (ms) | 437.5 (428.0–752.9) | 433.3 (423.2–676.9) | -0.9 % |
| Median TTFT (ms) | 174.3 (171.9–176.0) | 172.6 (171.1–176.7) | -0.9 % |
| Mean TPOT (ms) | 30.49 (30.31–31.60) | 31.20 (30.26–31.78) | +2.3 % |
| Median TPOT (ms) | 31.85 (31.50–31.96) | 31.83 (31.57–32.07) | +0.0 % |

With MTP, main logs `Fused multi-step draft decode is not supported by attention backend(s) DEEPSEEK_SPARSE_SWA; falling back` and this PR does not. Mean acceptance length is 2.92 on both arms.

**GSM8K** (strict-match):

| model | main | main (repeat) | PR |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| DeepSeek-V4-Flash | 0.9568 | 0.9545 | 0.9522 |
| DeepSeek-V4-Flash, MTP × 3 | 0.9560 | 0.9538 | 0.9530 |
| DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash | 0.9174 | 0.9098 | 0.9060 |
| Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (does not reach this path) | 0.7036 | 0.7036 | 0.6975 |

Per-sample agreement with main (1319 samples) is 1258 for the PR and 1252 for the base repeat on V4.1, and the two are within 7 of each other on the other three models, so the score differences are run-to-run variation.

---

Found by [Hyperloom](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Hyperloom); reviewed and measured by hand.

+def _build_ragged_reference(
+    indices: torch.Tensor,
+    lengths: torch.Tensor,
+    num_rows: int = -1,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    rows = []
+    for row, length in zip(indices, lengths.tolist()):
+        row = row[: max(length, 0)]
+        keep = row >= 0
+        if num_rows >= 0:
+            keep &= row < num_rows
+        rows.append(row[keep])
+    ragged = torch.cat(rows) if rows else torch.empty(0, dtype=torch.int32)
+    indptr = torch.zeros(len(rows) + 1, dtype=torch.int32)
+    torch.cumsum(
+        torch.tensor([r.numel() for r in rows], dtype=torch.int32),
+        dim=0,
+        out=indptr[1:],
+    )
+    return ragged, indptr
+
+
+def _build_ragged_reference_out(
+    indices: torch.Tensor,
+    lengths: torch.Tensor,
+    out_indices: torch.Tensor,
+    out_indptr: torch.Tensor,
+) -> None:
+    ragged, indptr = _build_ragged_reference(indices, lengths)
+    out_indptr.copy_(indptr)
+    out_indices[: ragged.numel()].copy_(ragged)

## e2e results, per run

MI355X (gfx950), torch `2.12.0+rocm10.0.0`, aiter `0.1.23`, `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1`. Both arms run upstream main `72e7874fa6` Python on the image's compiled build (vLLM `0.30.1rc1.dev312+g36768d1bf`); the PR arm adds this diff only.

Every run starts a fresh server and waits for `/health`:

```bash
vllm serve <model> --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --max-model-len 8192 --no-enable-prefix-caching \
    --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 --trust-remote-code
vllm bench serve --backend vllm --model <model> --dataset-name random --random-input-len 1031 \
    --random-output-len 509 --random-range-ratio 0.25 --num-prompts 509 --max-concurrency 61 \
    --request-rate inf --ignore-eos --seed 1234
```

- Each arm runs in blocks of 4 consecutive runs. The first run of each block warms the compile caches and is not listed.
- Host load is the 1-minute load average when the bench started → when it ended.
- TTFT and TPOT are in ms.
- `<model>` is DeepSeek-V4-Flash or DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. V4.1 runs with `--tensor-parallel-size 2`; the MTP config adds `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1` and `--speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":3}'`.
